content:
GOAL: audit BRad-RQ check 1 (behaviour signal boundary/statistic/connected pathway) and check 2 (SID training/export consistency).
READ: the whole delivered tree at /home/wlia0047/ar57/wenyu/GeneRec/results/research/issue121/trees/round_20261029_093253_576/BRad-RQ (read through an allowed file:// fetch because the read tool rejects external dirs). The tree contains exactly four files: train_rqvae.py (29813 B), model/layers.py (17547 B), model/behaviour_radius.py (4798 B), model/frechet_poincare.py (9359 B). model/model.py, model/__init__.py and tests/test_radial_export.py return ENOENT, although the brief's diff claims model/model.py and tests/test_radial_export.py changed.
OBSERVED: behaviour_radius.py now exists and implements the frozen statistic faithfully (context_entropy_scale lines 27-57, rank_radii 60-68, squash 71-76 = exp_0 o clamp, assignment_score 93-97, radii_for_switch 100-105). train_rqvae.py:437-446 reads only TRAIN_FILE and builds the edges; :447 applies the behaviour switch; :473 passes radius=radii[item_ids] into model(...). layers.py:89-97 radial_cost = assignment_score(squash(latent), squash(code), use_geometry=layer._use_geometry) and :156-157 argmin selects the code. Both switches are wired: USE_BEHAVIOUR->median radius, USE_GEOMETRY->squared Euclidean in the same radial_cost.
DEFECT: no code in the delivered tree applies the radius to the latent. grep over all four files finds scale_by_radius/set_radii only at train_rqvae.py:448-449, and that call is inside 'if hasattr(raw_module, "set_radii")' so it is a silent no-op against the inherited RQVAE; the consumer of radius= at :473 (RQVAE.forward) and get_indices live in the absent model/model.py. from model import RQVAE (train_rqvae.py:37) cannot resolve because the tree has no model/__init__.py and no model.py.
OPEN: whether the promoted run overlays the tree on a baseline model.py. If it does, the baseline get_indices has no radius (r1 finding 5) and the exported SID is angle-only; if it does not, the trainer does not import at all. Both are blocking. Statistic edge source tail(1) per user is accepted as the deduplicated full-sequence reading the author describes (rows are sliding prefixes); noted as a residual assumption, not blocked.

FINAL: NEEDS_FIX (blocking). Check 1 and check 2 both NEEDS_FIX. Delivered tree = train_rqvae.py, model/layers.py, model/behaviour_radius.py, model/frechet_poincare.py only. model/model.py and model/__init__.py are absent although the brief's diff claims model/model.py changed; no code in the tree multiplies a latent by the behaviour radius, 'from model import RQVAE' (train_rqvae.py:37) cannot resolve, and set_radii is behind a hasattr guard (:448) so the radius never reaches assignment_score. Export (:582-585, get_indices) therefore cannot apply the radius while training (:473) does, so the exported SID is not the trained assignment (squash/exp_0 maps every |z|>=0.9 to the single norm 0.7163, making the export angle-only). Minor findings: transition counts rely on an unverified per-user prefix ordering (train_rqvae.py:437-444 could drop earlier sessions); the claimed radius_table is persistent=False so a checkpoint re-export silently goes radius-free. Statistic formula, training-only boundary and both switches are correct; global-uniqueness extension (_extend_collisions + assertion) is deterministic. Full formatted answer printed in the reply.
